com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Multiattack
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Alric makes two Sword Cane attacks, or one Sword Cane and one Hand Crossbow attack.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Melee Weapon Attack [1d20+5] to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. [1d8+2] piercing damage.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Hand Crossbow
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Ranged Weapon Attack [1d20+5] to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. [1d6+2] piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or have its speed halved until the end of its next turn.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Everyone Has a Price (Recharge 5-6)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: One creature within 30 ft. that can hear Alric makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw (advantage if it has already refused his offer tonight). On a failure it is charmed until the end of its next turn and can't attack him or target him with harmful spells.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Bonus Action: Deep Pockets (each once)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Smokestick: 10-ft.-radius heavily obscured sphere for 1 minute. Alchemist's Fire: [1d20+5] to hit, range 20 ft., [2d6] fire at the start of each of the target's turns until put out with an action. Flash Vial: creatures within 10 ft. of a point within 30 ft. make a DC 14 Constitution save or are blinded until the end of their next turn. Healing Draught: regains [4d4+4] HP. Scattered Purse: a 10-ft. square within 15 ft. becomes difficult terrain for the rest of the fight.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Reaction: Close Call
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: When a creature Alric can see attacks him, he adds 3 to his AC against that attack.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Tactics
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Smoke or flash first, then the crossbow from cover. Everyone Has a Price on whoever is about to land the killing blow. Fights alone.

Sword Cane: The cane comes apart in {name}'s hands, and the thinner half is a blade.
{name} thrusts with the elegance of a man who has rehearsed this in a mirror.
A flick of the wrist from {name}, almost bored. Steel follows.
Hand Crossbow: {name} produces a crossbow no longer than a hand from somewhere inside his coat.
A click, a hiss. {name}'s bolt is tipped with something that makes the legs heavy.
Everyone Has a Price (Recharge 5-6): "Whatever they're paying you," {name} says pleasantly, "I'll double it. Tonight. In coin."
{name} names a figure. It is a very good figure.
"Walk away," {name} says, "and I'll remember you kindly. I remember everyone."
Bonus Action: Deep Pockets (each once): {name}'s coat seems to have more pockets than a coat should. One of them has something nasty in it.
{name} tosses something small and glass underarm, like a tip to a doorman.
Reaction: Close Call: {name} sways back half an inch. It's enough.
"Careful," {name} says, as the blow misses him by a hair.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: When Bram drops below 38 HP, or an ally drops to 0 HP, he must use his next turn to escape if a route is open, taking the Dash or Disengage action.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Bram makes two Cudgel attacks, or one Cudgel attack and one Grapple.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Cudgel

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Grapple

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Bonus Action: Bolt
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Bram takes the Disengage action and moves up to his speed, ignoring difficult terrain while moving away from enemies.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Reaction: Shove Clear
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: When a creature moves within 5 ft. of Bram, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be shoved 10 ft. away.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Tactics
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Hits hard for a round or two, then Coward's Instinct takes over. Runs rather than hides; cornered, he talks.

Cudgel: {name} swings the cudgel short and ugly, the way it's done in alleys.
No flourish from {name}. Just the club, aimed where it hurts.
{name} brings the cudgel down with the tired patience of a man who's done this before.
Grapple: {name} grabs a fistful of coat and hauls it in close, putting a body between himself and the blades.
"Easy now," {name} mutters, arm locking round a neck.
Bonus Action: Bolt: {name} is off, low and quick, over crates and through gaps only someone local would know.
{name} decides this is no longer his fight, and moves accordingly.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: One ally within 30 ft. can move up to their full speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Costin has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Oath of the Cycle
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Costin is sworn to Aeron and Zareth together, as the old Everbloom keepers were. The cycle answers him unevenly: Zareth's half comes readily, Aeron's half only faintly.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Once per turn, when Costin hits with a Longsword, he adds one of these. Wither: the target takes an extra [2d8] necrotic damage. Bloom: the target takes an extra [1d8] radiant damage, and one creature of Costin's choice within 10 ft. of him, other than Costin, regains hit points equal to the radiant damage dealt.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Reaction: Parry
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Costin adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. He must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Tactics
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Doesn't want this fight and never strikes first. Opens with Parry and Bloom (healing whoever he's just been talking to, if they're hurt) rather than Wither. At half hit points or below he lowers his sword and talks: he fears the gods far more than anything mortals can do to him, and says so. Against Rot: Wither's necrotic heals Rot creatures; only Bloom's radiant hurts them. Costin can't heal himself, which is why a Rot infestation would send him to Sorastra's Rest.

Longsword: {name} cuts with the economy of someone trained by people who didn't waste anything.
The longsword moves in a slow-looking arc that somehow arrives early.
{name} attacks without anger, as if pruning.
Cycle Strike (3/Day): Where {name}'s blade bites, the flesh greys and withers, as though a season has passed in a heartbeat.
Light runs down {name}'s blade like sap. What it takes from one, it gives to another.
"Everything ends," {name} says. "Everything returns." The blade agrees with him.
Reaction: Parry: {name} turns the blow aside with a twist of the wrist, unhurried.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Tactics
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Never starts the fight: words, then Plea, then the mallet once someone is hurt. Disarms and knock-downs before damage. Doesn't run or beg. Morning on the Docks with dockhands watching and a rotten half-jetty underfoot.

Mallet: {name} swings the mallet with regret in his face and none in his arm.
The mallet is a tool, not a weapon. {name} uses it like both.
{name} aims for the hand, not the head. He means to stop this, not end it.
Plea (Recharge 5-6): "Enough," {name} says, and something in his voice makes the room listen.
{name} raises an open hand. "Stop. Please. Nobody else has to bleed tonight."
{name}'s voice carries the weight of every sickbed he's ever sat beside.
Lay on Hands (65 HP pool): {name} kneels and lays a palm flat. Warmth spreads, and something dark lets go.
{name} murmurs a word that isn't quite a prayer. The wound closes like a mouth that's finished speaking.
Reaction: Turn the Blow: {name} catches the strike on the mallet's haft and turns it aside.
{name} steps into the blow rather than away, and it lands on nothing it meant to.

Forge Hammer: {name} brings the hammer down the way he's brought it down ten thousand times on an anvil.
The hammer comes round in a wide, honest arc. There's nothing clever about it. There doesn't need to be.
{name} grunts and swings. The air moves out of the way first.
Grapple: A hand like a vice closes on a collar. {name} doesn't let go of things.
{name} reaches out with arms scarred from a lifetime of sparks.
Hurl: {name} lifts, turns, and throws, like tossing a sack of coal into the bunker.
For a moment someone is airborne. {name} looks mildly satisfied.
Banked Coals (Recharge 5-6): {name} rakes open the forge. The coals breathe out.
A shovel scrapes iron, and {name} sends a spray of white-hot coals across the floor.
Bonus Action: Second Wind (Short Rest): {name} rolls his shoulders, spits, and sets his feet again.
{name} breathes in the heat of the forge like it's feeding him.
Reaction: Stand Firm: It's like trying to shove the anvil. {name} doesn't move, and then the hammer does.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Read the Room
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Seva can't be surprised, and she has advantage on initiative rolls.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Prepared for This (2/Day)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: When Seva fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: The Back Stair
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Moving through a doorway, curtain or window costs Seva no extra movement, and she doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when she leaves through one.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Multiattack
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Seva makes two Hairpin attacks, or uses Whispered Doubt and makes one Hairpin attack.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Hairpin
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Melee Weapon Attack [1d20+7] to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. [1d4+4] piercing damage plus [2d6] poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Whispered Doubt (Recharge 5-6)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: One creature within 30 ft. that can hear Seva makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it is charmed until the end of its next turn: it can't attack Seva, and on its turn it must use its action to make one attack against a creature of Seva's choice, or do nothing.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Bonus Action: Cunning Action
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Seva takes the Dash, Disengage or Hide action.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Reaction: Not Where You Thought
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: When a creature Seva can see hits her with an attack, she halves the damage and moves up to 10 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Tactics
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Opens with Whispered Doubt on the strongest attacker. Attacks, then hides or disengages. Below 41 HP she uses The Back Stair and runs. Fights alone.

Hairpin: {name} draws a pin from her hair in one smooth motion, as if tidying it, and drives it home.
A glint of silver at {name}'s temple, gone before anyone sees it move.
{name} steps in close enough to whisper. The pin does the talking.
The pin's tip is dark with something that isn't ink. {name} doesn't waste it.
Whispered Doubt (Recharge 5-6): {name} leans to an ear and says something quiet and reasonable. It sounds very much like the truth.
"Are you sure they're on your side?" {name} asks, gently, as though she already knows the answer.
{name} smiles as if you've shared a secret. Perhaps you have.
Bonus Action: Cunning Action: {name} is there, and then she is somewhere else, and nobody saw her go.
{name} gathers her skirts and slips between the guests like a rumour.
Reaction: Not Where You Thought: The blow lands on silk and air. {name} is already a step to the left.
{name} turns with the strike like a dancer, and is somewhere else.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Breaks Early (Trait)

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Loyal — holds the stairs
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Tav controls the only exit. He does not abandon his position at the stairs unless Oskar is down. He stays longer than is wise.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Hand Axe (melee)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Melee Weapon Attack [1d20+4] to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. [1d6+2] slashing damage.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Hand Axe (thrown)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Ranged Weapon Attack [1d20+4] to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. [1d6+2] slashing damage.

notes.Hand Axe (thrown): Thrown on round 1 only before closing to melee.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Disengages if Radek Falls
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Thessaly will not continue fighting without Radek. She uses her remaining movement to put distance between herself and the party.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Fire Bolt (Cantrip)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Ranged Spell Attack [1d20+5] to hit, range 120 ft., one target. [1d10] fire damage.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Magic Missile (Level 1 Slot)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Three darts automatically hit. Each dart deals [1d4+1] force damage. All darts can hit the same or different targets.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Thunderwave (Level 1 Slot)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Each creature in a 15 ft. cube makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On fail: [2d8] thunder damage and pushed 10 ft. On success: half damage, not pushed.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Hold Person (Level 2 Slot, Concentration)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: One humanoid within 60 ft. makes DC 13 Wis save or is paralyzed up to 1 minute. Repeat save at end of each turn.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Fog Cloud (Level 1 Slot, Concentration)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: 20 ft. radius heavily obscured sphere within 120 ft. Lasts up to 1 hour.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Minor Illusion (Cantrip)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Creates a sound or image within 30 ft. lasting 1 minute. DC 13 Investigation to disbelieve.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Dagger
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Melee Weapon Attack [1d20+4] to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. [1d4+2] piercing damage.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Bonus Action: Misty Step (Level 2 Slot)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Thessaly teleports up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space she can see.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Reaction: Shield (Level 1 Slot)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: When hit by an attack, Thessaly gains +5 AC until start of next turn including against the triggering attack. Uses a Level 1 slot.

forge.com.battle-system.forge/Z041: Spell save DC 13, spell attack +5. Slots: 4x Level 1, 3x Level 2.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: While below half HP, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Relentless (Trait, 1/fight)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: If reduced to 0 HP, drops to 1 HP instead.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Protects the escape (Trait)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Fights to buy Devrin time, not to win outright. Doesn't chase or press an advantage -- holds ground between the party and her, and breaks off only once she is genuinely clear.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Relentless
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Tomas does not disengage, retreat, or yield. He must be reduced to 0 HP to stop fighting.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Committed (above half HP)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: While above half his maximum HP, Tomas has advantage on all attack rolls.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Home Advantage
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Tomas knows every corner of the basement. He uses alcoves and tight spaces to deny the party room to manoeuvre.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Improvised Weapon
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Melee Weapon Attack [1d20+4] to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. [1d4+2] bludgeoning damage.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Casts Once and Leaves
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Ysolde casts Thunderwave on her first turn then uses her remaining movement to walk away. She does not engage further under any circumstances.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Each creature in a 15 ft. cube makes DC 13 Constitution save. On fail: [2d8] thunder damage and pushed 10 ft. On success: half damage, not pushed.
